content: Bininj nawu kabirrihni kore kubolkkimuk Judah kabirriburrbun nawu God. Dja bininj nawu Israel benkebmawahmeng wanjh kabirringeyburlume nuye.
Nungka nawu God kahdi kore kunred nuye Jerusalem.
Nungka wanjh kahyo kore kuwarddekimuk Zion.
Kumekbe wanjh nungka bakkeng arrows bedberre nawu birriyidko nuye, dja mak bakkeng rowk bedberre mandjawak dja njalehnjale rowk birrikarrmi bu kabirriburrenkenh.
Manbu kuwarddekimuk manbolkmakkaykenh, wanjh yeng. Dja ngudda wanjh yidjalwernhmakkaykenh, ngudda nawu God duninjh.

Yibenbom rowk nawu ngurriyidkoni bininj. Bedda nawu birrikelebukni, dja bonj, yibenmarnedjirdmey manmakmak bedberre, dja bolkkime wanjh kabirridjalngudyawarren, dja wanjh kabirridjalkodjkeyo kore kundowikenh.
Ngudda Jacob nuye God, bu ngudda yibenmarnebuhmeng kukeb ke, wanjh birrimekbe bininj dja mak djarrang bedberre, birridoweng dja minj mak kabirrirokan.
Wanjh kunmekbekenh ngad wanjh ngarriwarlahkenh bininj ngundikengeme ngudda nawu Yawey. Bu ngudda yiyiddung wanjh minj nangale bininj kahdangen kore kumirrk ke!

Ngudda yidjalyerrkang kore kaddum heaven dja kunmekbe ngudda yibenwarrewam nawu ngundiwirrihmeng bu yibendjadmeng rowk. Dja ngad ngarriwarlahkenh bininj kondah kurorre, wanjh ngarridjalwokyakni kunkele dorrengh.
Ngudda yirranginj bu yidjalwokdanj bu kandjadmekenh. Ngudda kunu yibenngehkeng bininj nawu kabirribongdi kondah kurorre.
Bu bininj ngundidung, wanjh bonj, yibenmarnbun bu ngundidjalburlume ngudda. Ngad nawu kandarrkidbawong wanjh ngundidjalkengeme.

Mah, ngurrimarnewokkurrmerrimen nuye Yawey nawu God ngudberre, dja ngurridjalkurduyimen kore ngurrimulewarrinj. Mak ngudda nawu ngurrini kubolkbubuyika darnkih, wanjh ngurrimka nuye namakmak dja ngurriwo. Nungka wanjh kanmarnbu ngad bininj rowk bu karrikengeme nuye!
Nungka kabenkangewarrewon nawu birrikihkimuk bininj nawu kabindiwohrnawohrnan, dja mak nawu kings bedberre birrikihkimuk. Wanjh bedda kabirrikengeme nahni nawu God.
